description: This Java class 'AuditAware' serves as a base class to provide auditing information such as creation and modification timestamps and user identifiers for derived entities in a JPA-based persistence layer.

classes.name: AuditAware
classes.description: A base class that adds auditing fields (created/modified date and user, version) to entities, with JPA annotations for persistence and Lombok annotations for getters/setters.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user who created the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the user who created the entity.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the entity was last modified.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the entity was last modified.

methods.name: getModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user who last modified the entity.

methods.name: setModifiedBy
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the user who last modified the entity.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number for optimistic locking.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version number for optimistic locking.
